answer: To register, an agent locks a stablecoin deposit held in escrow as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. random spot-checks on the canonical chain exposes any agent caught countersigning a transaction never verified. When the proof lands, a fraud proof triggers slashing at once, no jury needed. Think of the bond as a tundra: locked, visible, forfeitable. A farm needs a fresh canyon per fake, each costing a full bond. An oasis that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
